reasons.plausibility: The mechanisms proposed (grain refinement, defect sinks, etc.) are scientifically consistent with known effects of Re doping in refractory HEAs under irradiation.
reasons.testability: Well-defined microstructural and mechanical characterization routes (TEM, nanoindentation, micropillar compression) provide a clear way to confirm or refute the predicted improvements in irradiation resistance.
reasons.usefulness: Because it focuses on a different alloy system and does not address CoCrFeNiTi or the question of its low hardness and strength, it provides negligible direct guidance for researchers on that exact topic.
